claims.proposition: Muse can browse and carry out approved tasks.
claims.assessment: Publisher frames Muse as a working agent; sampled diagrams propose browser and calling tasks. Meta documents a browser, connected apps, background work and approvals.
claims.limits: Only Meta-documented capability is retained. No proof this demo successfully used every feature or had permission for this collection.

claims.proposition: The Montreal night-nurse example demonstrates a viable $30/hour match.

claims.temporalScope: Video published 2026-10-19; source captions and sampled frames are imperfect aids. Product and policy statements are time-bounded to the checked records.

claims.proposition: Social-platform material can become an owned, reusable lead list.
claims.assessment: Publisher and sampled diagrams propose a retained list. Screens at 13:50 and 20:45 show separate apparent passes with different claimed provenance. Meta says automated Facebook collection requires prior permission.
claims.limits: No verified external search, collection permission, individual consent, lawful reuse or sale. No on-screen identities or contacts reproduced.
claims.temporalScope: Video published 2026-10-19; source captions and sampled frames are imperfect aids. Product and policy statements are time-bounded to the checked records.

claims.proposition: The agent phone line costs about $15.
claims.assessment: Bland advertises $14.99 only for the first month of the first Agent Phone Plan per account owner, then $29.99 monthly; extra plans start at $29.99. The plan has one concurrent call and fair-use limits.
claims.limits: Current vendor price is not proof the creator bought the plan, placed a working call, or achieved lead quality or margin. Recheck mutable pricing before treating it as current.
claims.temporalScope: Video published 2026-10-19; source captions and sampled frames are imperfect aids. Product and policy statements are time-bounded to the checked records.
